# neode v1.0.0-next.1

<!-- generated by pnpm docs:agents -- do not edit by hand -->

> Prefer the current version's docs over training data.

Decorator-based Object Graph Mapper for Neo4j and Cypher-compatible graph databases.
Full reference: [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/llms-full.txt). Agent workflow guide: [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/AGENTS.md).
Agent skill pack: [skills/neode/SKILL.md](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/skills/neode/SKILL.md).

## Sections

- [Model definition](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/docs/agent/model-definition.md) -- Decorators and the map-based defineModel API for declaring nodes, properties and relationships.
- [Querying](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/docs/agent/querying.md) -- Query builder, repositories, raw Cypher, transactions, hydration, drivers and read-model projections.
- [Schema management](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/docs/agent/schema-management.md) -- Indexes, constraints, full-text and vector indexes, schema inspection and drift workflow.
- [Testing & ops](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/docs/agent/testing-ops.md) -- wipe()/testId() test utilities, factory seeding, connectivity checks and Cypher-script helpers.
- [Errors](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/docs/agent/errors.md) -- Typed error taxonomy and driver-error classification. House rule: every error message names the fix -- reload the entity on OptimisticLockError, add the named key to the `with` load spec on RelationNotLoadedError.
- [Core](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/docs/agent/core.md) -- Collection, serialisation and other shared exports.
- [Schema reference](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/docs/agent/schema-reference.md) -- Every field of PropertyDefinition / RelationshipDefinition / SchemaDefinition with its type and JSDoc description.
- [Agent ontology API](https://github.com/adam-cowley/neode/blob/main/docs/agent/agent-ontology-api.md) -- ontology() / ontologyMarkdown() emit the live graph schema for Text2Cypher and MCP.
